book.title: Gelindo Kunlade Huaisan Ji 1 Hui Xin

content: Bi kunni buxiantu kielienyi kieliezhi qienxienyi kielienyi kielieliuzhe oreku wise tunguliesan laba, gu niekielien wo.
Made Hudai kielienyi kielieku nenli bizhi yanyanji chijia daoliji erlinni mejiezhi ulai noighaku fugie xianxin gieku biliuzhe oreku wise bi yama pusho.
Bi baerlane man nanxin kunde ogizhi beyene kunlade oluzhi tulieghaliuzhe oreku wise made yama haochu uwo.
Oreku izhi rennai giene, renyi wo, ulie dubiliene, goyane ulie kuaizhi zishi ulie shuaine,
limao witui ulie giene. Zi goyadene oluzhi ulie giene, suibiende ho ulie kuruzhi kunlai chouni ulie bareine.
Gou winide xiqi uwo, zhendaode xiqi wo.
Yandeliuzhe aghuide sumulane, soyujilai man xianxin giene, soyujilai man xiwon giene, soyujilai man rennai giene.
Hudai kielienyi kielieku, psedu kielienyi kielieku, erlin enela jianlai man baranema, oreku chanqi ulie barane.
Matan mejiesanshi ezighan wo, Hudai kielien kieliesanshi ezighan woma,
Bi ga shihoude kielieku, sumulaku, jiejin giekula man ga kunyi xianli, fugiedase ga kunnughunyi man widaghawo.
Matan ede belijide uzhesan mutun qinchude ese uzhezhoma, hhe xienzi kuse mienduimien uzhene. Bi ede mejiesanshi ezighan woma, hhe xienzi kuse Ezhan mii man mejiesan mutun bi man mejiene.
Xianxin gieku, xiwon gieku, oreku chan wine. Ene ghuron dundase orekushi zui fugieni wo.
